instruction.text: Jace is drinking milk. Each carton of milk contains <mat><t-yellow>4</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> of a litre. He drinks <mat><t-yellow>8</t-yellow>/<t-purple>9</t-purple></mat> of a carton’s worth. How many litres of milk did he drink?

atoms.a: Write the answers in a fraction.

instruction.text: Jamila is reading a book. She reads <mat><t-yellow>2</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> of it on the first day and <mat><t-yellow>1</t-yellow>/<t-purple>2</t-purple></mat> of the remaining book on the second day. What fraction of the book did she read on the second day?
instruction.sound: Jamila is reading a book. She reads <mat><t-yellow>2</t-yellow>/<t-purple>5</t-purple></mat> of it on the first day and <mat><t-yellow>1</t-yellow>/<t-purple>2</t-purple></mat> of the remaining book on the second day. What fraction of the book did she reed on the second day?

atoms.a: Write the answers in a fraction.
atoms.b: Jamila read <mat><gap>3</gap>/<t-purple>10</t-purple></mat> of the book on the second day.

instruction.text: Hassan is calculating the area of a rectangular garden with a length of <mat><t-yellow>2</t-yellow>/<t-purple>3</t-purple></mat> of a metre and a width of <mat><t-yellow>3</t-yellow>/<t-purple>4</t-purple></mat> of a metre. What will be the total area of the garden in square metres?

atoms.a: Write the answers in a fraction.
atoms.b: The garden will have a total area of <mat><gap>6</gap>/<t-purple>12</t-purple></mat> square metres.

atoms.a: Write this fraction in its simplest form.

instruction.text: Emma is building a model car using <mat><t-yellow>5</t-yellow>/<t-purple>6</t-purple></mat> of <mat><t-yellow>7</t-yellow>/<t-purple>11</t-purple></mat> of a kit. What fraction of a kit does Emma use?
instruction.sound: Emma is building a model car using <mat><t-yellow>5</t-yellow>/<t-purple>6</t-purple></mat> of 7 elevenths of a kit. What fraction of a kit does Emma use?

atoms.a: Write the answers in a fraction.

instruction.text: Ben is dividing cakes equally among his 4 friends. If he cuts the cakes into <mat><t-yellow>6</t-yellow>/<t-purple>7</t-purple></mat> pieces and each friend eats <mat><t-yellow>7</t-yellow>/<t-purple>8</t-purple></mat> of a piece, how much cake did each friend eat?

atoms.a: Write the answers in a fraction.
atoms.b: Each friend would eat <mat><gap>42</gap>/<t-purple>56</t-purple></mat> of a cake.

atoms.a: Write this fraction in its simplest form.
